title: Bold and Wildheart theme pages run on Nocturne's layout with real renders

source.ref: Theme readiness audit 2026-11-03: /themes/bold and /themes/wildheart were the generic six-section page with 'picture on the way' boxes

detail: One template (frequency-theme-feature.tsx, copied from the New World page) draws both: hero with the surface switcher, the four surfaces joined by a dotted line, Today, Try it on, Inside the kit, Make it yours, Starter kits, What carries over, Built right, Questions and Setup. Every surface is a real render (scripts/render/theme-pages-shots.render.tsx and theme-pages-shots.mjs write public/brand/theme-pages/<theme>/{site,spot,spacedesk,email}.jpg): the real site chrome and blocks for the theme's starter kit, the real Spotlight shell on its preset, a Space inside the real member shell, and the real campaign mail. The pictures borrow the existing warm gathering photos (Wildheart its own set) until each theme has a library of its own (asset, on the owner's list). Default has no page: New World is the default (owner ruling 2026-11-03). Spotlight layouts and kit emails are not drawn: these themes have none.
